scenes.name: THE LOCK OF THREE
lines: Nineteen integer points sit on a sphere of squared radius eight hundred sixty-seven.
平方半径 867 的球面上，恰有十九个非负整点。
Cycling the coordinates fixes one pole and sorts the other eighteen into six orbits of three.
轮换坐标，极点 (17, 17, 17) 不动，其余十八点分成六条三点轨道。
If both quark mass matrices respect that cycle, mixing can only be a permutation with phases.
若上下两套夸克质量矩阵都保持这一轮换，混合就只能是置换乘相位。
So the symmetry must break. But by how much?
所以对称必须破缺：可要破到多深？

scenes.name: THE BREAKING FLOOR
lines: Distinct cube roots of unity sit root three apart, so the commutator measures distance from symmetry.
互异的单位立方根彼此相距根号三，于是对易子量出离对称有多远。
Feed in conservative mixing bounds on V c b and V t b.
代入 |V_cb| 与 |V_tb| 的保守下界。
Five lines of algebra then force at least one sector to break the cycle by more than zero point zero four one four.
五行手算随即迫使至少一个部门的轮换破缺超过 0.0414。

scenes.name: FIVE WALLS
lines: Then natural mechanisms on the shell hit certified walls.
接着，最自然的几种机制在球壳上一一撞上有证书的墙。
A single light Higgs leaves charm over top more than seven times too heavy.
单支轻希格斯给出的粲顶比，比实测重了七倍多。
Density potentials keep top over bottom below thirty on all twelve hundred thirty-eight zeros.
任意站点密度势在全部 1238 枚零点上都把顶底比压在 30 以下；自然界要 40 以上。
Richer transport fits one zero, but at a vacuum cost above ten to the thirty-four.
更丰富的输运能拟合单枚零点，代价却是超过 10 的 34 次方的真空系数。

scenes.name: RATIONAL CAYLEY
lines: Rebuilding mixing needs exact rotations. Cayley's recipe makes them from rational vectors.
重建混合需要精确的旋转。凯莱的配方用有理向量造出它们。
Take s equal to one third, two thirds, two thirds: every entry is a whole number of ninths.
取 s = (1/3, 2/3, 2/3)：旋转矩阵的每一个元都是九分之几。
Lean checks the law for every rational s: Cayley transposed times Cayley is the identity.
Lean 内核对任意有理 s 检验这条规律：凯莱矩阵的转置乘它自己，等于单位阵。
And Lean checks that turning by p times q is turning by q, then by p.
Lean 还检验：按四元数 pq 转，等于先按 q 转、再按 p 转。

scenes.name: SAME GRAM, ONE TURN
lines: Second tool: two matrices with one Gram matrix, four, two, two, five.
第二件工具：两个矩阵共用一张格拉姆矩阵：4、2、2、5。
Lean checks: whenever B star B equals A star A, some unitary U carries A onto B.
Lean 内核检验：只要 B*B = A*A，就有幺正矩阵 U 把 A 送到 B。
Folding into three generations needs room: forty-two dimensions per side, forty-five across zero Higgs.
折进三代需要空间：每侧至少 42 维；跨过零希格斯，则需 45 维。

scenes.name: CALIBRATED, THEN RIGID
lines: Positive reconstructions exist: a mirror triangle of zeros rebuilds the reference C K M in twenty-eight windings.
正向重构确实存在：由零点组成的镜像三角，绕二十八圈就重建出参考 CKM。
A finite rational response, calibrated on one zero, matches all seven to ten to the minus eleven.
有限有理响应在一枚零点上校准，就在全部七枚零点上逼近到 10⁻¹¹ 以内。
No fixed matrix can stand in: five zeros shrink local ones to scalars, seven shrink all to polynomials in the cycle.
固定矩阵替代不了：五枚零点让局域者只剩标量，七枚让一切成为轮换多项式。
So the mixing law must move with the background.
所以混合法则必须随背景而动。

scenes.name: THE OPEN FLAVOUR HORIZON
lines: What stays open: every successful mixing is calibrated to data, not derived.
仍然开放的是：每一次成功的混合都由数据校准，而非推导得出。
And one folding for all quark and lepton masses and mixings is still unsolved.
用同一个折叠给出全部夸克与轻子的质量和混合，仍未解决。
The walls are measured. The door is not yet found.
墙已量清，门还没找到。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter eight.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第八章
